name: Member's Mark USDA Choice Angus Beef New York Strip Steak
whyItWorks: High-grade Angus beef strip steak has fine marbling rather than coarse chewy gristle. Cooked medium-rare to medium, it breaks down cleanly in the stomach and provides dense zinc and iron.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Trim the outer strip of white fat before eating. Season with salt only and pair with a baked potato (skin removed).
